title: Chinese Valentine's Day
synopsis: The Qixi Festival is often called the Chinese Valentine's Day. Here we learn the story of how this festival came to be.

fullText.simplified:
中国的情人节

    每年的农历七月七日，是中国的传统节日—七夕节，又被称为中国的情人节。说到七夕，人们就会想起牛郎织女的传说，这是一个美丽的，千古流传的爱情故事，是中国四大民间爱情传说之一。
    牛郎是一个贫穷而快乐的单身汉，与他相依为命的只有一头老牛。一天，天上的织女和其他仙女一起下凡游戏，牛郎在老牛的帮助下认识了织女。两人有了感情，后来织女便偷偷下凡，来到人间，做了牛郎的妻子。牛郎和织女结婚后，生了一男一女，一家人生活得很幸福。可是好景不长，织女偷偷下凡的事情被王母娘娘发现了，她非常生气，亲自下凡强行把织女带回天上，牛郎和织女被分开了。
    牛郎想去追织女，但是他只是凡人，不能上天。就在牛郎发愁的时候，与他相依为命的老牛说话了。老牛说：“你把我杀了，披上我的牛皮，就能上天了。”牛郎说什么也不愿意这样做，但是拗不过它，又没有别的办法，只能含着泪把老牛杀了。
    牛郎披上老牛的皮，拉着自己的儿女一起上天去追织女。眼看就要追到了，王母娘娘大怒，拔下头上的金簪一挥，一道天河就出现了，牛郎和织女被隔在两岸，只能相对哭泣流泪。他们的爱情感动了喜鹊，千万只喜鹊飞来，搭成鹊桥，让牛郎和织女走在鹊桥上相会。王母娘娘对此也没办法了，只好允许两人在每年七月七日于鹊桥相会。
    后来，每到农历七月七日，相传牛郎织女鹊桥相会的日子，姑娘们就会来到花前月下，抬头仰望星空，希望能看到他们一年一度的相会，祈祷自己能有美满的婚姻，由此形成了七夕节。
    现在，人们更多的把七夕节看作是中国的情人节，在七夕节这一天，情侣们会互赠礼物，一起度过这个节日。
fullText.traditional:
中國的情人節

    每年的農曆七月七日，是中國的傳統節日—七夕節，又被稱為中國的情人節。說到七夕，人們就會想起牛郎織女的傳說，這是一個美麗的，千古流傳的愛情故事，是中國四大民間愛情傳說之一。
    牛郎是一個貧窮而快樂的單身漢，與他相依為命的只有一頭老牛。一天，天上的織女和其他仙女一起下凡遊戲，牛郎在老牛的幫助下認識了織女。兩人有了感情，後來織女便偷偷下凡，來到人間，做了牛郎的妻子。牛郎和織女結婚後，生了一男一女，一家人生活得很幸福。可是好景不長，織女偷偷下凡的事情被王母娘娘發現了，她非常生氣，親自下凡強行把織女帶回天上，牛郎和織女被分開了。
    牛郎想去追織女，但是他只是凡人，不能上天。就在牛郎發愁的時候，與他相依為命的老牛說話了。老牛說：“你把我殺了，披上我的牛皮，就能上天了。”牛郎說什麼也不願意這樣做，但是拗不過它，又沒有別的辦法，只能含著淚把老牛殺了。
    牛郎披上老牛的皮，拉著自己的兒女一起上天去追織女。眼看就要追到了，王母娘娘大怒，拔下頭上的金簪一揮，一道天河就出現了，牛郎和織女被隔在兩岸，只能相對哭泣流淚。他們的愛情感動了喜鵲，千萬隻喜鵲飛來，搭成鵲橋，讓牛郎和織女走在鵲橋上相會。王母娘娘對此也沒辦法了，只好允許兩人在每年七月七日於鵲橋相會。
    後來，每到農曆七月七日，相傳牛郎織女鵲橋相會的日子，姑娘們就會來到花前月下，抬頭仰望星空，希望能看到他們一年一度的相會，祈禱自己能有美滿的婚姻，由此形成了七夕節。
    現在，人們更多的把七夕節看作是中國的情人節，在七夕節這一天，情侶們會互贈禮物，一起度過這個節日。

sentences.english: Speaking of Qixi, for many the tale of the Cowherd and the Weaver girl will come to mind.
This is a beautiful love story that has been passed on since the beginning of time, and is one of China's Four Great Love Folktales.

sentences.simplified: 牛郎在老牛的帮助下认识了织女。
sentences.traditional: 牛郎在老牛的幫助下認識了織女。

sentences.english: The two developed feelings for one another, and the weaving girl later secretly descended to the world.

sentences.english: She came down to the human world and became the cowherd's wife.

sentences.english: After the cowherd and the weaving girl got married they had a boy and a girl, and the family lived happily.

sentences.english: But the happiness did not last, because the weaving girl's secret descent to the world was discovered by Xi Wangmu.
In a fury she personally descended to the world and forced the weaving girl to return to the heavens, separating her from the cowherd.

sentences.simplified: 但是拗不过它，又没有别的办法，只能含着泪把老牛杀了。
sentences.traditional: 但是拗不過它，又沒有別的辦法，只能含著淚把老牛殺了。

sentences.pinyin: zhǐ néng xiāng duì kū qì liú lèi

sentences.english: Their romance touched the magpie birds, and ten million birds came flying.

sentences.simplified: 王母娘娘对此也没办法了，只好允许两人在每年七月七日于鹊桥相会。

sentences.english: They created a bridge of birds, allowing the cowherd and the weaving girl to walk up and meet on the bridge.
Xi Wangmu had no choice but to allow the two to meet on the bridge on the 7th day of the 7th month every year.

sentences.traditional: 祈禱自己能有美滿的婚姻，由此形成了七夕節。

raw.synopsis: The Qixi Festival is often called the Chinese Valentine's Day. Here we learn the story of how this festival came to be.
sentence_translations: Chinese Valentine's Day
Every year on the 7th day of the 7th month of the lunar calendar is China's traditional festival: Qixi Festival.
It is also called the Chinese Valentine's Day.
Speaking of Qixi, for many the tale of the Cowherd and the Weaver girl will come to mind.
This is a beautiful love story that has been passed on since the beginning of time, and is one of China's Four Great Love Folktales.
The cowherd is a poor but happy bachelor who owned only one ox: the old ox which he was mutually dependent on.
One day, the weaving girl and the other fairies in the heavens descended to the world together to have fun.
The cowherd got to know the weaving girl through the help of the old ox.
The two developed feelings for one another, and the weaving girl later secretly descended to the world.
She came down to the human world and became the cowherd's wife.
After the cowherd and the weaving girl got married they had a boy and a girl, and the family lived happily.
But the happiness did not last, because the weaving girl's secret descent to the world was discovered by Xi Wangmu.
In a fury she personally descended to the world and forced the weaving girl to return to the heavens, separating her from the cowherd.
The cowherd wanted to follow the weaving girl, but he was just an ordinary man and could not rise to the heavens.
Just when he was lamenting over this, his mutually dependent old ox spoke up.
The old ox said: “If you kill me and put on my oxhide, you will be able to go the the skies.”
The cowherd did not want to do this no matter what.
But unable to persuade the ox and with no other choice, he killed the old ox with tears in his eyes.
The cowherd draped the oxhide over his shoulders, and pulled his children with him as he went up to the skies to find the weaving girl.
When he was just about to reach her, Xi Wangmu got angry.
She pulled out the golden hairpin from the top of her head and gave it a wave.
The Milky Way appeared, separating the cowherd and the weaving girl on opposite shores, ...
.. and they could do nothing but face each other and cry.
Their romance touched the magpie birds, and ten million birds came flying.
They created a bridge of birds, allowing the cowherd and the weaving girl to walk up and meet on the bridge.
Xi Wangmu had no choice but to allow the two to meet on the bridge on the 7th day of the 7th month every year.
Later on, each time on the 7th day of the 7th month, the day the cowherd and the weaving girl meet on the bridge, ..
.. girls would go out amidst the flowers under the moonlight and raise their heads to the heavens in hopes of seeing the annual meeting.
They pray that they will have a blissful marriage, and like this the Qixi Festival was formed.
Nowadays, people often see Qixi Festival as the Chinese Valentine's Day, ..
.. and on this day lovers will give each other presents and spend the festival together.
